utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the third of August. Can you all hear me before I spend five minutes talking to myself?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, loud and clear. Sorry I'm a bit flustered, traffic on the ring road was absolutely solid.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: You and half the early shift. Lovely start to a Monday.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And the football last night didn't exactly improve my mood. What was that second half about?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I knew we'd get to the football before anything mechanical.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Well, plenty of things failing to function in both, wasn't there?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Right, expert analysis over. Let's get through the factory bits.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Um, am I coming through? Teams has picked the wrong microphone again.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: You're fine now. Bit distant, but we can hear you.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Good. Finished work first, so we don't carry anything over that's already closed.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I signed off the inspection on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve on Tuesday. That's done.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Last Tuesday, yeah? Just putting that in the right week in my head.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, last Tuesday. Already signed off, not something outstanding for today.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And I finished the repair on the HV switchboard last night.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: That's finished finished, rather than nearly finished?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Finished finished. Repair's closed, nothing to carry forward from that.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Sorry, I was talking over you there. Heard the last bit, all good.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Right. My safety item next.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the BFP by Thursday. That one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: So Thursday's the completion deadline, not when you're starting it?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Exactly. I'll get onto it straight away, with the sign-off done by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Grace has the BFP sign-off. Clear.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Understood. Safety critical, not sitting in the routine queue.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Sarah, what have you got from the shift?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: First off, the shutdown on the dryer is cancelled now, production need it running.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, so that shutdown isn't part of today's work any more.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No, cancelled. Not a shutdown we're still trying to squeeze in.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I will swap the filter on the CT1 by 11am, though. Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Sorry, CT1 filter, did you say? Your audio clipped right on the number.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, CT1. I'll do the filter swap by 11am, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Cheers, Sarah. That's with you.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Just an observation from me: saw the pressure on the IM1 hydraulic unit dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: It recovered without anyone doing anything to it?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah. Just describing what I saw, not putting a repair on today's list.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Similar observation here. Saw the pressure on the Line 2 Safety Guard Interlock dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Sorry—sorry, go on. Was that the label you said, Line 2 Safety Guard Interlock?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's the one, yeah. Again, just the observation and the recovery. I'm not proposing another job off that in this meeting.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Okay, both observations, not agreed work items. What about the outstanding deliveries?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Still blocked, I'm afraid. Same lack of confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: The supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the forklifts.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: So no confirmed delivery to work from there?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: No. And the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the Fire Alarm Panel either.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Both still in the blocked column, then, rather than things happening today.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Exactly. No confirmed dates. Those are blocker updates, not new actions.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Right, separate from those deliveries, we've got the contractor site visit.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Cal, can you do a site visit at Tollgate with the contractor? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll do the site visit at Tollgate with the contractor. Happy to take that.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: With the contractor there, rather than a separate look round?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, with the contractor. Tollgate visit, normal priority, understood.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Lovely, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: David Whitfield, can you send the shift handover report round today?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Full name, blimey. Yeah, I'll send the shift handover report round today.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: The shift handover report, yeah? Not a separate quality report?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's right, just the shift handover report. I'll send that round today.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Thanks. Full name doesn't always mean you're in trouble, honestly.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Reassuring. And I'll book a contractor to look at the GT2 water valve on Monday. Low priority, that one.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Davey, just so that's clear: booking on Monday, not promising the contractor will actually attend on Monday?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, exactly. Monday as in today, I'll make the booking. It's low priority; I'm not giving an attendance date.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And that's separate from my Tollgate visit with the contractor?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, separate item. Mine's booking a contractor to look at the GT2 water valve.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Fine, that distinction makes sense.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Right, that's the agreed work. Finished items stay closed, deliveries still blocked, and the dryer shutdown is cancelled. Thanks, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Cheers. Nice to have one of these where Teams only ate half a sentence.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Don't tempt it. Cheers, all.
